If you look at a 30-60-90 triangle, remember that tangent is the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side. The one opposite the 60 is longer. So if I put the opposite over the adjacent, I should get the larger value. But is it $\sqrt{3}$? Just say yes or no!
